name: touchgrass
description: An AI that wants you to stop using it.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/web && npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@touchgrass/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@touchgrass/api && npm run test --workspace=@touchgrass/web
